Tecothy is a Petrified drow ranger in the Underdark.

Involvement

Act One

Tecothy and several other drow are  Petrified on a battlefield west of the Selûnite Outpost. The  Spectator can unpetrify them during combat, which causes the drow to become immediately hostile to the party. If the drow are unpetrified after the spectator is killed, the party can interact with them peacefully.
